claims.claim: The Israeli postal code (mikud) is looked up per address through the Israel Post lookup form; there is no official public API.
claims.raw_snippet: איתור מיקוד איתור המיקוד לפי: כתובת ת.ד יישוב
claims.source_note: The page is client-rendered; read in Playwright with location.href asserted.

claims.claim: Israel Post's mikud lookup is a web form at doar.israelpost.co.il/locatezip; there is no official public mikud-by-address API. The bennymeg/IsraelPostalServiceAPI library is a shipping-price calculator, not a mikud lookup.

GovMap publishes an official API documentation site at api.govmap.gov.il covering URL parameters, HTML embedding and JavaScript functions, including advanced search functions that work without an embedded map; the national map portal itself is at govmap.gov.il.
claims.raw_snippet: פורטל המפות הממשלתי, GovMap, מספק יכולות שיתו

claims.claim: The Survey of Israel block/parcel-by-address (gush/helka) tool is at gov.il/apps/mapi/parcel_address/parcel_address.html; the old mapi.gov.il/Pages/LotAddressLocator.aspx path was retired and now redirects to a generic landing page.

data.gov.il hosts the street dataset "רשימת רחובות ישראל" and the locality dataset "רשימת ישובים בישראל", queryable through the CKAN datastore_search API. The record fields are the Hebrew names סמל_ישוב, שם_ישוב and שם_ישוב_לועזי (there are no city_code / city_name_he / city_name_en fields).
The Israel Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS / Lamas) is the statistical authority behind the settlement and locality code list; its media releases are published at cbs.gov.il.
claims.raw_snippet: על פי אומדני הלשכה המרכזית לסטטיסטיקה
